paragraphs.text:
The wind picks up, fanning the flames into an inferno, which 
sweeps down through the scrub of the hillside and into the 
forest.  Sylvia  and  Norman  cough  as  branches  around  you 
crackle  and  the  conflagration  spreads. You  race  through  the 
smoke, half blind.
Make a Luck roll: if you succeed, go to 404; if you fail, go to 405.
